images.role: The rendered fraction-driven decorative strip: no label, no ARIA value, fill width 10% translated by the active index.
images.decisionImpact: Measured progress is activeIndex / count (2 / 10 = 20%, translateX(200%) on a 32px fill inside a 320px track), not (activeIndex + 1) / count as the Foundation TipsSlider README documents. The design system takes the value from the host and expresses it as value={20}; the README/page disagreement is reported as owner question Q3.

limits: The captures show the web's local .tips-prog/.fab-prog markup, which writes the fraction differently from the Foundation .eg-progress component (in-place width/translate versus scaleX). They are evidence for the rendered values, not approved expected design for the ProgressBar recipe.

VIS-03 is a padded clip rather than an element crop because the strip is two pixels tall; the 10% fill width and the translateX offset are recorded in the observed styles so the arithmetic can be re-checked without pixels.
The tips rail images are Jinja placeholders in the source and fail to load; the VIS-03 crop excludes the cards and VIS-04 captures the controls row, so no broken image is shown.

In the /tmp harness document.fonts.check('600 13px Barlow') returned false while the condensed 600 check returned true; only the small .meta captions use the sans family and the bars themselves are CSS.
VIS-06 records live JavaScript state from the preview's range input script (30 of 100), not a static design value.
Browser images do not verify behaviour, accessibility, keyboard or focus behaviour.

PNG bytes can differ between runs of the same script (scroll-dependent compositing); the hashes above are of the files stored in this folder and must be re-verified with sha256sum before linking them in any published comment.

approval.reference: Pending: the owner approves or declines these captures as supporting evidence for ProgressBar v0.2 in issue #65. The captures are source evidence and grant no expected-design approval.
